parent.notes: Alerts now arrive when the app is closed. Safe-zone entry and exit alerts name the child and the zone (for example Aarav entered Home) and show once per crossing. SOS, low battery, speed and other alerts are also checked in the background. A small always-on notice keeps the checks running about every 30 seconds, with a 15-minute backup job. Settings warns if notifications or the battery exemption are off.

client.notes: Report interval can now be changed from the child app (7 choices, one-time parent sign-in). Tracking restarts when the app opens, and the Health screen warns when notifications or battery optimization are off, with buttons to fix them.
